items.quote: I highly recommend Gabe for all household projects. He has done a significant amount of work at my home, and the quality of his workmanship has been excellent. He can handle remodeling, carpentry, finish work, masonry work and more.
I had my kitchen completely remodeled by this company, including new cabinets, and I couldn't be happier with the results. The cabinets look beautiful.
Gabe arrived on time, worked efficiently, and quickly installed the new garbage disposal unit. He took care that there were no leaks and even put everything back under the sink. I highly recommend!
